title: SPaCe: Unlocking Sample-Efficient Large Language Models Training With Self-Pace Curriculum Learning
authors_zh: Dai Do, Manh Nguyen, Svetha Venkatesh, Hung Le
paper_type_zh: 自定步强化微调的数据选择与调度研究
best_for_zh: 为可验证推理强化微调构建紧凑自适应课程的读者。
one_line: SPaCe reduces a reasoning pool by semantic-difficulty clusters and uses a progress-aware bandit to schedule RFT samples.
SPaCe 以语义—难度簇缩减推理池，再用感知进展的老虎机调度强化微调样本。
why: It makes record coverage and changing training exposure jointly explicit in a low-budget RFT policy.
inclusion_reason: It changes both the retained reasoning records and their online sampling frequency during reinforcement fine-tuning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reinforcement fine-tuning commonly draws batches uniformly from a full reasoning dataset. This gives equal budget to already solved problems, redundant near-neighbors, and examples too difficult to yield useful feedback. Static curricula can have the same failure: a threshold fixed before training cannot follow a learner whose competence changes during optimization.

SPaCe asks two coupled data-use questions: which compact subset should remain available for reinforcement fine-tuning, and which part of that subset should be sampled at each moment. Its intervention is a training-data policy rather than a new reward model. The aim is to keep semantic coverage while concentrating updates on clusters that are challenging, learnable, and still making progress for the current model.

强化微调常从完整推理数据集中均匀抽取批次。这会把相同预算给已解决的问题、冗余的近邻以及过难而无法提供有效反馈的例子。静态课程也可能有同样失败：训练前固定的阈值无法跟随优化过程中能力持续变化的学习者。

SPaCe 追问两个相互耦合的数据使用问题：哪一个紧凑子集应继续可供强化微调使用，以及在每个时刻应从该子集的哪一部分采样。它干预的是训练数据策略，而不是新的奖励模型。目标是在保留语义覆盖的同时，把更新集中在对当前模型而言具有挑战、可学习且仍在进步的簇上。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The framework first makes a stable, reduced training pool. It represents every example by a semantic embedding and a scalar attribute such as difficulty, clusters the concatenated representation, and chooses diverse representatives inside every cluster by farthest-point sampling. Each cluster becomes a persistent curriculum unit, so selection can reduce redundancy without discarding an entire kind of problem.

It then treats the clusters as arms of a multi-armed bandit. During GRPO-based training, online solve rates update each arm; low solve rate denotes hardness, while a stagnation penalty prevents the scheduler from repeatedly choosing a cluster that remains hard but no longer improves. Thompson sampling balances uncertain clusters against difficult ones. Thus the same reduced records are not uniformly consumed: their sampling frequency changes with observed learning progress.

该框架先构造一个稳定、缩减后的训练池。它用语义嵌入和诸如难度的标量属性表示每个例子，对拼接表示进行聚类，并通过最远点采样在每个簇内选择多样代表。每个簇成为持久的课程单元，因此选择可减少冗余而不丢弃整类问题。

随后它把这些簇视作多臂老虎机的臂。在基于 GRPO 的训练中，在线解题率更新每个臂；低解题率表示困难，而停滞惩罚防止调度器反复选择仍然困难却不再进步的簇。汤普森采样在不确定簇和困难簇之间平衡。因此相同的缩减记录不会被均匀消费：它们的采样频率随观察到的学习进展改变。

title: Method
方法
html:
Before training, SPaCe extracts embeddings with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, reduces dimensions with PCA, standardizes the embedding and one per-example attribute, and applies k-means. It chooses a fixed quota from each cluster using greedy farthest-point sampling. The clustering is intentionally performed only once, preserving a stable identity for each bandit arm; changing clusters online would invalidate accumulated solve-rate statistics.

At each training step, Thompson sampling selects one cluster from its hardness and pull-count statistics. A batch from that cluster receives binary correctness rewards and updates both GRPO and the selected arm's cumulative reward. If a cluster's solve rate fails to improve by a tolerance for consecutive updates, its sampling mean is reduced. The main experiments use DeepScaleR subsets, GSM8K, MATH, and Knights and Knaves; with at most ten clusters and ten representatives per cluster, several settings train on no more than 100 examples.

训练前，SPaCe 使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 提取嵌入，用主成分分析降维，对嵌入和一个逐例属性进行标准化，并应用 k 均值聚类。它利用贪心最远点采样从每个簇选择固定配额。聚类被有意只做一次，以保持每个老虎机臂的稳定身份；在线改变簇会使已累积的解题率统计失效。

每个训练步骤中，汤普森采样根据困难度和抽取次数统计选择一个簇。来自该簇的一个批次获得二元正确性奖励，并同时更新 GRPO 和被选中臂的累积奖励。若一个簇的解题率在连续更新中未能超过容差改善，其采样均值会降低。主实验使用 DeepScaleR 子集、GSM8K、MATH 和骑士与无赖；在至多十个簇且每簇十个代表的若干设置中，训练使用的例子不超过 100 条。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On DeepScaleR-Uniform, Qwen3-0.6B with SPaCe reaches 79.8 on GSM8K, 78.2 on MATH500, 20.0 on AIME24, and 18.9 on AIME25. The corresponding base scores are 78.0, 75.4, 10.0, and 16.7; the standard GRPO baseline is below SPaCe on all four. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, SPaCe reports 72.4, 81.1, 25.6, and 26.7, respectively, and is best on three of the four tests.

The paper averages three seeds for the main learned baselines and tests mathematics, logic puzzles, several data distributions, and models from sub-billion to 8B scale. On Knights and Knaves, it reports 9.9 average accuracy versus 8.1 for GRPO and 7.8 for AdaRFT. Removing the reduction stage lowers Qwen3-0.6B AIME24 from 20.0 to 12.2, supporting the claim that diversity-preserving reduction matters. The authors also show that the scheduler increasingly samples medium-hard clusters with rising solve rates, rather than becoming trapped in easy regions.

在 DeepScaleR-Uniform 上，使用 SPaCe 的 Qwen3-0.6B 在 GSM8K、MATH500、AIME24 和 AIME25 上分别达到 79.8、78.2、20.0 和 18.9。相应的基础分数为 78.0、75.4、10.0 和 16.7；标准 GRPO 基线在四项上均低于 SPaCe。对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B，SPaCe 分别报告 72.4、81.1、25.6 和 26.7，并在四项中的三项最佳。

论文对主要学习型基线取三个随机种子平均，并测试数学、逻辑谜题、多种数据分布以及从十亿参数以下到 8B 的模型。在骑士与无赖上，它报告平均准确率 9.9，而 GRPO 和 AdaRFT 分别为 8.1 与 7.8。去掉缩减阶段会使 Qwen3-0.6B 的 AIME24 从 20.0 降至 12.2，支持保留多样性的缩减确实重要这一主张。作者还显示调度器会越来越多地采样解题率上升的中等困难簇，而不是被困在容易区域。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier data reduction can select a one-off subset, while curriculum methods can order examples through a fixed or threshold-based difficulty rule. SPaCe combines the two at the object that training consumes: a semantically and difficulty-aware reduced pool is prepared once, then its clusters are scheduled online using rewards from the learner. This makes data coverage and temporal allocation explicit parts of one training policy.

The distinctive decision is not simply to select difficult questions. A cluster remains attractive when it is hard and still improving; stagnant hardness is penalized. Equally, its reduction stage is not a global top-k difficulty filter: every cluster supplies representatives, preserving semantic variety before the bandit decides frequency. The claimed contribution is therefore a progress-sensitive curriculum over a deliberately compact record set.

早期数据缩减可以选择一次性的子集，而课程方法可以通过固定或基于阈值的难度规则排列例子。SPaCe 把二者结合在训练所消费的对象上：先准备语义和难度感知的缩减池，再利用学习者奖励在线调度其簇。这使数据覆盖和时间分配成为同一训练策略中明确的部分。

其独特决策不是简单选择困难问题。一个簇在既困难又仍在进步时才保持吸引力；停滞的困难会受到惩罚。同样，它的缩减阶段并非全局的最高难度前 k 过滤：每个簇都会提供代表，在老虎机决定频率之前保留语义多样性。因此其声称的贡献是对有意压缩的记录集合实施进展敏感的课程。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The experiments cover models smaller than 8B, so scale behavior for larger systems is not established. The method needs a suitable per-example attribute and an embedding model before training; noisy difficulty annotations or poorly chosen clusters can make the arms less meaningful. It also relies on outcome correctness rewards and is demonstrated on mathematical and logical reasoning, not open-ended tasks with subjective feedback. The paper reports use of the Open-R1 codebase and upstream datasets but does not provide an author-declared standalone implementation or new data release, so reproducibility requires reconstructing the selection and scheduling details from the paper and respecting each upstream artifact's terms.
实验覆盖的模型小于 8B，因此在更大系统上的规模行为尚未确立。该方法在训练前需要合适的逐例属性和嵌入模型；带噪声的难度标注或选择不佳的簇会使老虎机臂失去意义。它还依赖结果正确性奖励，且只在数学和逻辑推理中展示，而非带主观反馈的开放任务。论文报告使用 Open-R1 代码库和上游数据集，却未提供作者声明的独立实现或新数据发布，因此复现需要从论文重建选择与调度细节，并遵守各上游制品的条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use SPaCe when an RL or RFT budget is too small to sample a reasoning pool uniformly and when each prompt has a defensible scalar attribute such as difficulty. Preserve the pool revision, embedding checkpoint, PCA and normalization settings, cluster count, per-cluster quota and representative IDs, reward extractor, bandit prior and stagnation rule, decoding configuration, and every selected cluster over time. Compare with uniform GRPO and a static curriculum at equal rollout and update budgets. The method is most useful where one needs to explain not only which examples were retained but why their exposure frequency changed during training.

当强化学习或强化微调预算过小、无法均匀采样推理池，并且每个提示具有可辩护的标量属性如难度时，可使用 SPaCe。应保留数据池版本、嵌入检查点、主成分分析与标准化设置、簇数、逐簇配额与代表标识、奖励提取器、老虎机先验与停滞规则、解码配置以及每个时刻被选择的簇。应在相同展开和更新预算下与均匀 GRPO 和静态课程比较。该方法最适用于需要解释的不仅是保留了哪些例子，而且是为何它们在训练中的暴露频率发生改变的场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read SPaCe as two decisions with different time scales. Clustering and farthest-point reduction are a one-time decision about coverage; the bandit is an online decision about allocation of the next batch. Its reported small-data result does not mean any 100 examples suffice: those examples are chosen in relation to a specified pool, embedding, difficulty attribute, learner, reward, and scheduler. The limitation section is particularly important because the work has not shown that the same policy transfers to larger or non-verifiable settings.
应将 SPaCe 读作两个具有不同时间尺度的决策。聚类和最远点缩减是关于覆盖的一次性决策；老虎机是关于下一批分配的在线决策。其报告的小数据结果并不表示任何 100 个例子都足够：这些例子是相对于指定的数据池、嵌入、难度属性、学习者、奖励和调度器选择的。局限部分尤其重要，因为该工作尚未证明同一策略可迁移到更大或不可验证的环境。
